method: VITE_TEST_HOOKS=1 build served on 127.0.0.1:5214 (gzip for text types, no cache). Fresh browser context per viewport (desktop DSF 2; phone DSF 3, isMobile, hasTouch). Download = bytes the server sent from navigation until 2 s of network silence. States: first load, then each module tab (and its cinematic sub-state while a shot plays). Medium preset forced after the download measurement. Alive: two canvas-only screenshots 5 s apart, 3x3 grid, a region counts when >= 0.25% of its pixels change by > 12/255. Performance: 4 s sample per state; GPU time from EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 around each requestAnimationFrame dispatch; draw calls and triangles counted at the WebGL call level (all passes), max over the sample.
